body:
I have been addicted to opiates and/or opioids for 10 to 15 years. This experience happened at least 5 years ago (maybe slightly more).
When returning to my home state of Arkansas from California, I took a (legally) very large amount of Acid with me (Acid is a slang word used to describe the drug LSD) and the young woman who I lived with back then as well as now says I had 37 Sheets of acid when I first moved in with her and I would have quickly become dope sick from opiate withdrawal if I didn't have such a large amount of LSD.  I don't remember how many hits of the weak LSD I started with, or how long it took me to increase the dose to 100 hits at a time during the withdrawal, taken once every 2 days.  The LSD high lasted a long while, as it usually does, but it's been at least 5 years since then and I don't really recall how long the trip lasted, but I don't think that it lasted substantially shorter or longer than it usually does.  I didn't remember many specifics of it at all, just that my dose was in total increased to 100 hits at a time, once every 2 days.  I probably felt a tiny amount of withdrawal, but I just don't remember.
To give you an idea of how addicted I was, let me mention that before the withdrawal began, I used opiates/opioids all day, everyday, for at least a month.
[Reported Dose: '100 hits of LSD-related ergoline (extremely weak per hit) once every 2 days and a good amount of High Grade Cannabis smoked all day everyday.']
